property_summary: For any amount and any recipient contract, when the owner calls withdraw(amount) the reference contract always reduces address(c).balance by exactly amount (transfer either succeeds or the call reverts), whereas the mutant that uses an unchecked .call can leave address(c).balance unchanged if the recipient's fallback reverts, violating that invariant for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace transfer to send call that does not revert on failure (uses .call and ignores success), allowing partial or failed sends without reverting.
